text: Start with a PowerPoint theme you already trust. Bento-deck-studio reads its colors, type, slide size, layouts, and candidate image assets without changing the source. Review the extracted theme tokens before you build, and let them shape the story.

Next, give Copilot a topic, outline, or Markdown script. The authoring flow turns it into native bento slides, not flattened images. Each slide gets one message, clear hierarchy, and an editable layout you can revise without losing the message.

Before writing the file, the deck builder checks Bento's signed release manifest and verifies the shell hash. A supplied image can become the favicon, or the site can generate a theme-colored monogram. The checks run before the deck is written, so release integrity comes first.

By default, the result is a simple launch page with the presentation one click away. Choose the full companion site for a menu and story sections. Slides is the first menu item and opens a read-only deck in a new tab, while the deck stays editable and the site remains easy to host.

Before sharing, validate the structure, review every slide in a browser, and check links and the favicon. The public deck copy removes speaker notes and collaboration credentials. Your theme, your narrative, and a more considered way to present, ready to share after one final review.
